'''''Thinopyrum''''' is a [[genus]] of Eurasian and African plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>Löve, Áskell. 1980.  Taxon 29(2–3): 351</ref>

==Species==
The following species are recognised in the genus ''Thinopyrum'':<ref>{{cite web |title=Thinopyrum Á.Löve |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:1190729-2 |access-date=14 September 2022 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |language=en }}</ref>
*''[[Thinopyrum acutum]]'' <small>(DC.) Banfi</small> - Europe, Turkey
*''[[Thinopyrum bessarabicum]]'' <small>(Savul. & Rayss) Á.Löve</small> - Black Sea and Aegean regions
*''[[Thinopyrum corsicum]]'' <small>(Hack.) Banfi</small> - [[Corsica]]
*''[[Thinopyrum curvifolium]]'' <small>(Lange) D.R.Dewey</small> - Spain
*''[[Thinopyrum distichum]]'' <small>(Thunb.) Á.Löve</small> - Cape Province; naturalized in Western Australia
*''[[Thinopyrum × duvalii]]'' <small>(Loret) Banfi</small> - France, Italy, Turkey
*''[[Thinopyrum elongatum]]'' <small>(Host) D.R.Dewey</small> - Mediterranean, Middle East
*''[[Thinopyrum flaccidifolium]]'' <small>(Boiss. & Heldr.) Moustakas</small> - Turkey, Greece, Albania, Sicily
*''[[Thinopyrum gentryi]]'' <small>(Melderis) D.R.Dewey</small> - Turkey, Iran
*''[[Thinopyrum intermedium]]'' <small>(Host) Barkworth & D.R.Dewey</small> - central and southern Europe; central and south-western Asia; naturalized in North America
*''[[Thinopyrum junceiforme]]'' <small>(Á.Löve & D.Löve) Á.Löve</small> - northern and central Europe, Selvagens, Morocco; naturalised in Australia
*''[[Thinopyrum junceum]]'' <small>([[Carl Linnaeus|L.]]) Á.Löve</small> - Mediterranean, Canary Islands, Madeira, Caucasus; naturalized in Australia, New Zealand, Oregon, California, Falkland Islands
*''[[Thinopyrum obtusiflorum]]'' <small>(DC.) Banfi</small> - Europe and Caucasus
*''[[Thinopyrum podperae]]'' <small>(Nábelek) D.R.Dewey</small> - Turkey, Iraq, Iran
*''[[Thinopyrum turcicum]]'' <small>(P.E.McGuire) B.R.Baum & D.A.Johnson</small> - Turkey, Iraq, Iran
*''[[Thinopyrum varnense]]'' <small>(Velen.) B.R.Baum & D.A.Johnson</small> - south-eastern Europe
